html:
The Tsleil-Waututh, "the people of the inlet", are a Coast Salish First Nation of Burrard Inlet, in what is now North Vancouver, British Columbia. səl̓ilwətaɁɬ təməxʷ is their name for their land.

They speak Halkomelem and are closely tied to their neighbours the Musqueam, the Squamish and the Kwikwetlem. They lived from salmon, clams and the forests of the inlet. The city of Vancouver grew up on and around their land from the 1880s.

The actor Chief Dan George was Tsleil-Waututh. In recent years the nation led opposition to the expansion of the Trans Mountain oil pipeline, whose terminal sits on the inlet. See also Coast Salish.
